observation: The first project-specific PHPStan rule test used PHPStan\Testing\RuleTestCase inside the normal PHPUnit process. Later WorkflowContext tests then failed inside agent-map because Composer\InstalledVersions could no longer locate phpstan/phpstan, even though the package was installed. Removing the in-process PHPStan testing runtime and executing the rule fixture in a separate PHPStan process restored the normal test matrix.

evidence.summary: CI run 31218074774 failed in four WorkflowContext tests with 'Unable to locate phpstan/phpstan installation' after the in-process RuleTestCase executed. CI run 31218247902 then passed PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5 after the rule fixture moved to tools/project-phpstan-rules.sh, while the project rule itself still produced the expected diagnostic.

hypothesis: Tooling test harnesses that load executable analysis runtimes into the application PHPUnit process can mutate global autoload or Composer package-discovery state and create unrelated order-dependent failures.
validated_conclusion: Test agent-loop project-specific PHPStan rules in an isolated PHPStan subprocess. Do not load PHPStan\Testing\RuleTestCase into the normal agent-loop PHPUnit process while agent-map also performs Composer-based PHPStan discovery in that process.
